text:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — planning a short APAC onboarding bootcamp for new accounts (remote). Thinking 3 x 90m sessions across two weeks. Who can rotate as trainers?

Ben (CS Ops): +1 to 90m blocks. I can cover SGT mornings (09:30).

Priya (Solutions): I can do Wed/Fri 10:00 SGT or Tue 16:00 SGT. I have deck v1.3 ready.

Liam (Trainer): Happy to rotate — prefer Mon/Wed. Available week of Apr 14 or Apr 21.

Sasha (AM): Can we split into two tracks: foundations (intro + best practices) and integration (APIs + infra)? We should surface renewal-risk accounts for the integration track.

Maya (CSM): Good call — propose: Track A = Foundations (90m), Track B = Integration (90m). Signup sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheet-placeholder (please add name, role, preferred slot).

OnboardBot: A new signup sheet has been created: "APAC Onboarding Bootcamp — trainer + attendee slots". 8 trainer/attendee slots open.

Priya (Solutions): I added a prereq checklist and sample prompts to the doc. Also noted which customers need token-budget guidance.

Ben (CS Ops): @Liam @Priya who can own the embeddings section and live lab? Need an SME for advanced topics.

Liam (Trainer): I can own embeddings + live lab. Thinking: split the session into 45m advanced + 45m hands-on labs.

Sasha (AM): I'll add VIP invites for Kestrel and Lumina (both renewal in Q2). They should be in integration track.

Maya (CSM): Draft schedule (SGT):
```
Week 1
- Tue 09:30-11:00 — Track A (Foundations)
- Thu 16:00-17:30 — Track B (Integration)
Week 2
- Tue 09:30-11:00 — Track A (Foundations)
```

Maya (CSM): Action items: 1) Trainers confirm week availability by EOD Thu (please reply here). 2) Ops to create calendar series + timezone-friendly invites. 3) Deck v1.3 -> final v1.4 by Mon (Priya to lead).

Ben (CS Ops): Noted. I'll create calendar series, add timezone conversions, and sync with GA calendar.

Priya (Solutions): I'll push deck updates and ping reviewers in #eng-docs.

Maya (CSM): If we get 6+ signups we'll open a second advanced lab. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can commit to being a trainer for one week.

Liam (Trainer): :thumbsup: I can commit week of Apr 14.

Sasha (AM): :thumbsup: I'll coordinate VIP invites and invite list filtering.

Ben (CS Ops): Will set up the calendar series and post the invite link here when ready.

Maya (CSM): Thanks — I'll send a confirmation and the calendar invites once we hit trainer minimum.

Priya (Solutions): Ping me for slide review — I'll aim to deliver v1.4 by Monday morning.

Maya (CSM): Great, thanks everyone!
